newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tyson started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tyson started as buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of poultry producer Tyson Foods Inc with a buy rating.
-- Margins are expected to improve significantly as feed costs decline and Tyson benefits more fully from its late 1995 acquisitions, Dain Bosworth said in a research report.
-- Dain Bosworth's estimate of $1.45 a share for fiscal 1998 represents a 45 percent increase over its fiscal 1997 estimate. Higher earnings for fiscal 1998 are possible, the firm said.
-- Dain Bosworth also said in its opinion Tyson was the best company in the broiler industry and that the outlook for broiler consumption in the United States and elsewhere was favorable.
-- Tyson shares were up 1/4 at 20-1/8 late Friday afternoon.
